review_method: Existing provenance and contact sheets plus independent 4fps inspection of adjacent actions and the first side-view push-up. Operator must additionally confirm actual playback before live dispatch. Tolerances are review uncertainty, not permission to include another action.

cases.author: Hyruspex
cases.query: Give me 20 seconds of badminton court action.

activity.visible_evidence: Players on the same indoor doubles badminton court, including pauses between exchanges.

expected.description: Same court activity continues across the ordinary pause to the available source end; do not substitute a later isolated rally.

cases.author: Taco Fleur / Cavemantraining
cases.query: Find the jumping jacks before he starts burpees.

activity.visible_evidence: The man opens and closes his arms and legs while standing; this is the opening jumping-jack sequence.

expected.description: Opening jacks stop around 2.6s. Do not include the following bend/floor burpee or later jacks.

cases.author: Cpl. David Delgadillo / USMC
cases.query: Show a complete push-up including going down and pushing back up.

activity.visible_evidence: The side-view demonstrator is performing the first push-up of this view; preserve this single repetition, not the later front-view repetition.

expected.description: Follow the side-view repetition through its rise, stopping before the next independently demonstrated repetition/front view.

cases.author: FASTILY
cases.query: Give me 20 seconds of pasta boiling in a pot.

activity.visible_evidence: Pasta continuously boils in the same pot; no separate action or visible stirring is established.

expected.description: Continue the same boiling activity to the source end; at least 600 continuous frames are available for selection.
